Jo: Quick sync — we need to lock on onboarding priority for next quarter: which model families first and what's the gating checklist?
Anya: Propose a 2-track sequence: low-latency smalls (7B) first, then high-quality 13/34B. Reason: ship wins for PLG usage and reduce cost.
Mike: Agreed on sequencing but want a clear RICE table per candidate. Customers asked for Llama-3-8b and Mistral-7b this week: that's demand signal.
Sanjay: RICE helps but we should include operational constraints (quantized kernel availability, memory footprint). Some models won't run on our dedicated infra without new kernels.
Eva: +1. Also legal/license check and model card evals before onboarding. We had a surprise flag last time.
Jo: Draft gating checklist: 1) License OK, 2) Eval pass on core prompts (>95% quality), 3) Latency P95 < target, 4) Cost/unit <= threshold, 5) Runtime supported (ops/km kernels), 6) Safety regression tests.
Anya: For metrics, suggest: Eval QA accuracy >= 95%, hallucination rate < 3%, P95 latency < 200ms for 8k tokens on dedicated profile, cost per 1k tokens < $X.
Mike: Can we be pragmatic on thresholds? Some customers prioritize quality over latency. Maybe make thresholds per 'class' (smalls, mids, large) and per deployment tier (hosted vs dedicated).
Sanjay: Sequencing decision factors: customer requests, infra readiness, quantization support, expected cost savings vs improved quality, rollback complexity.
Jo: Example quick RICE calc for Mistral-7b:
```
Reach = 12000 monthly requests
Impact = 2.5 (0-3 scale)
Confidence = 0.6
Effort = 3 engineer-weeks
RICE = (12000*2.5*0.6)/3 = 6000
```
Anya: That's helpful. But spreadsheet-level RICE across many small variants can bias toward high-reach smaller models — which is OK if our goal is PLG retention.
Eva: Also account for 'switch-cost' for customers: if a model variant breaks behavior, customer trust drops. Add weight to 'behavioral regression risk' in confidence.
Mike: Can we add a rollout plan stub to the checklist: canary to 5% traffic, evaluate quality deltas, auto-fallback to previous model for >X% regression.
Jo: Yes. Rollout policy + A/B eval harness required. Also need a migration path for cached prefixes and embeddings.
Sanjay: For immediate next picks I'd rank: 1) Mistral-7b (low effort, high reach), 2) Llama-3-8b (moderate), 3) Llama-3-70b distilled variant (high effort but strategic). Thoughts?
Anya: Sounds right. Add 'embedding parity' check if model will serve embeddings.
Eva: I'll start a quick eval run for Mistral-7b and Llama-3-8b. ETA 3 days for initial delta report.
Mike: I'll draft a one-row RICE table for top 6 candidates and share in this thread tomorrow.
Jo: OK. Action items: @Eva run evals, @Mike produce RICE table, @Sanjay verify kernel/quant support, @Anya draft gating thresholds per class. We'll reconvene Friday to finalize sequence. :thumbsup:

Anya: Thanks — adding customer requests into the ticket. :sparkles:
Jo: Great. If anyone sees a hard blocker (license or hardware) ping here immediately.
